categories.main_business_segments: Wuhu Token Sciences Co., LTD operates primarily in two main business segments: automotive electronics and consumer electronics. The automotive electronics segment includes vehicle sensors, sensor modules, 2D and 3D vehicle cover glass, display modules, and integrated touch-display modules for various car interiors. The consumer electronics segment covers ultra-thin LCD panel thinning, ultra-thin glass cover plates (UTG and UFG), ITO conductive glass, VR display modules, smart wearable display modules, smartphone, notebook (NB), and tablet (PAD) display modules, light guide plates, and electronic paper driver substrates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced vacuum coating, thin film, optical film, precision photolithography, glass surface treatment, and chemical technologies. It has developed proprietary ultra-thin glass thinning and forming processes, including flexible and foldable glass (UTG and UFG) with high bending and impact resistance. It also specializes in 3D curved glass forming for automotive displays, electrochromic (EC) technology for automotive rearview mirrors, and HUD (head-up display) curved reflective mirror technology. The company emphasizes vertical integration from conductive glass to full lamination of touch and display modules, supported by high automation and precision equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global customers in the consumer electronics and automotive electronics industries. Key clients include top-tier panel manufacturers such as Sharp, LGD, BOE, and smartphone brands like OPPO, Vivo, Huawei, Xiaomi, and Google. Automotive customers include major domestic and international car manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers such as BYD, NIO, Chery, Geely, Great Wall, Ford, Daimler, and Porsche. The products cater to high-end smartphones, foldable devices, VR headsets, smart wearables, notebooks, tablets, and intelligent vehicle cockpit displays.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in the Anhui Free Trade Zone, Wuhu. It has expanded overseas with a production base in Vietnam to better serve international markets. Its customer base and sales cover both domestic and international markets, with approximately 54% of revenue from domestic sales and 46% from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wuhu Token Sciences Co., LTD operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures key electronic materials such as ITO conductive glass and ultra-thin glass substrates, and assembles touch and display modules, including integrated touch-display modules for consumer and automotive electronics. The company provides one-stop solutions covering materials, components, and module assembly, positioning itself as a high-end display manufacturer with vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ultra-thin and flexible glass technologies, automotive display integration, and new display materials. Key R&D focuses include sliding roll ultra-thin flexible glass, large-area dynamic X-ray imaging sensors, infrared coating processes, Hybrid OLED thinning, electronic paper displays, and advanced automotive HUD components. It emphasizes strengthening its patent portfolio and expanding production capacity for foldable glass and automotive display modules, aiming to maintain technological leadership and capture emerging market opportunities in AI-enabled consumer electronics and intelligent vehicle cockpits.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic materials and display modules to major consumer electronics and automotive manufacturers. The company sells physical products including conductive glass, ultra-thin glass cover plates, touch and display modules, and automotive sensor modules. It also earns income from technology licensing and government subsidies related to innovation and production. The sales are predominantly contract-based with long-term supply agreements with leading industry customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the automotive electronics segment, main competitors include companies like Sunny Optical and Xinli. In the consumer electronics ultra-thin glass segment, Samsung is a key competitor, though the company employs a different technological route to avoid Samsung's patent barriers. In the display module and ITO conductive glass sectors, competitors include Woguo Optoelectronics, Kaisheng Technology, and Shengnuo Electronics. The company holds a leading position domestically with top market share in panel thinning and ultra-thin glass production, and is recognized as a leading supplier to high-end customers globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.06 billion, representing a 24.4% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose by 47.7% to about RMB 357 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 16.23 billion, up 13.57% year-over-year. It maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity, increased overseas investment, and strong demand in automotive and consumer electronics markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its vertically integrated supply chain, advanced proprietary technologies in ultra-thin and flexible glass, and comprehensive product offerings from materials to integrated modules. It emphasizes high product stability, yield, and cost advantages, serving high-end customers with customized solutions including 3D curved automotive glass and electrochromic rearview mirrors. Its innovation in flexible OLED wearable displays and VR modules further strengthens its competitive moat. The company’s ability to provide one-stop, high-quality, and cost-effective solutions to leading global brands underpins its market leadership.
